glasses_omar: I assumed fixed spots like bathroom_shelf_ba1 or bed_b1, but it was at nightstand_b1 at 07:00, coffee_table_l1 at 20:16, and nightstand_b1 at 22:31. Pattern: Highly variable; moves between bathroom, living room, and bedroom. Do not assume a fixed spot; check nightstand_b1, coffee_table_l1, and bathroom_shelf_ba1.

razor_omar: I assumed bathroom_shelf_ba1, but it was at sink_ba_ba1 at 07:00. Pattern: Location varies between shelf and sink. Check both bathroom_shelf_ba1 and sink_ba_ba1.

water_bottle_omar: I assumed sink_k1 or dish_rack_k1, but it was at kitchen_table_k1 at 19:30. Pattern: Often on the table in the evening. Check kitchen_table_k1 first, then dish_rack_k1.

glass_omar: I assumed sink_k1 or cupboard_k1, but it was at kitchen_table_k1 at 19:31 and nightstand_b1 at 22:30. Pattern: Moves from kitchen to bedroom at night. Check kitchen_table_k1 in the evening and nightstand_b1 late at night.

mug_omar: I assumed cupboard_k1, but it was at coffee_table_l1 at 20:17 and 21:28. Pattern: Frequently in the living room in the evening, not the kitchen cupboard. Check coffee_table_l1 before cupboard_k1.

charger_omar: I assumed entry_table_e1, but it was at nightstand_b1 at 22:30. Pattern: Moves to the bedroom at night. Check nightstand_b1 for late-night queries, entry_table_e1 for earlier times.

General: Items do not follow consistent time-based patterns. Evening locations are dynamic. Always consider multiple rooms (kitchen, living, bedroom, entry) rather than assuming a single fixed spot based on time of day.
